[[File:Dragonsnake_Bog.jpg|thumb|right|250px|[[Dragonsnake Bog/Legends|Dragonsnake Bog]], a swamp on [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]]]]
A '''swamp''' was [[Forest/Legends|forested]] wetland. They generally occurred where [[Water/Legends|groundwater]] met the surface, or in low-lying coastal areas near seas or [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]]. In some cases, such as on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]], a swamp environment could cover the entire surface.

Examples of swamps included the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], the [[Dulok Swamp]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]], and the [[Kajiin Swamp]] of [[Murninkam]].

Some species that resided in or around swamps included [[swamp wampa]]s, [[swamp womp rat]]s, [[Swamp slug/Legends|swamp slugs]], [[swamp bantha]]s, and [[swamp demon]]s. The [[Patitite/Legends|Patitites]] were diminutive sentient beings native to the swamps of [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]].<ref name="SWE Patitites">{{SWE|groups|patitites|Patitites}}</ref>

[[Swamp pickle]]s could be found on Endor.
